# Valence AI — Complete Product Reference

> Valence AI is an autonomous AI workforce platform. Deploy five specialized AI agents that execute research, writing, coding, CRM updates, and quality review across 100+ integrations — all from a single command center.

Website: https://usevalence.ai
Founded: March 2026
Founder: Arpit Dhamija
Contact: arpitdhamija.ai@gmail.com
Twitter: @arpit_dhamija

---

## What Valence AI Is

Valence AI (usevalence.ai) is an enterprise autonomous AI workforce platform. It is not a chatbot, assistant, or single-agent tool. It is a coordinated team of five autonomous AI agents — each with a distinct role — that collectively execute complex multi-step business missions across an organization's full technology stack.

Valence AI uses Anthropic's Claude models: Claude Opus 4.6 powers Kaze (the orchestrator), and Claude Sonnet 4.6 powers the four specialist agents. The infrastructure is deployed per-customer on dedicated servers.

Users issue natural-language missions from a single command center dashboard. The orchestrator agent decomposes each mission into subtasks, delegates to specialist agents, and synthesizes the final output. A QA agent reviews every deliverable before it reaches human review.

---

## The Five Agents

### Kaze — The Orchestrator
- Receives natural language missions from users
- Decomposes missions into subtasks and delegates to specialist agents
- Synthesizes final outputs from agent deliverables
- Never does the work itself — it manages the workforce
- Powered by Claude Opus 4.6

### Scout — The Researcher
- Monitors markets, competitors, customers, and industry trends
- Synthesizes intelligence briefs from web research, CRM data, and internal sources
- Performs lead enrichment and competitive analysis
- Powered by Claude Sonnet 4.6

### Forge — The Builder
- Writes and deploys production code
- Creates GitHub issues and pull requests
- Builds integrations and handles technical execution tasks
- Automates DevOps workflows
- Powered by Claude Sonnet 4.6

### Ghost — The Writer
- Drafts emails, blog posts, LinkedIn content, reports, case studies
- Writes all customer-facing communications
- Writes in the customer's brand voice
- Handles content repurposing and distribution
- Powered by Claude Sonnet 4.6

### Sentinel — The Monitor
- Reviews every deliverable against quality criteria before human review
- Audits agent decisions and flags anomalies
- Enforces output standards and compliance
- Acts as the QA gate for all agent work
- Powered by Claude Sonnet 4.6

---

## Key Differentiators

1. **Five specialized agents** vs single-agent tools: Each agent has defined expertise, a SOUL file governing its behavior, and distinct quality standards.
2. **Stack-agnostic**: Integrates with 100+ tools including Salesforce, HubSpot, GitHub, Jira, Slack, Google Workspace, Notion, Stripe, Shopify, and more.
3. **Autonomous execution**: Missions run server-side without human approval at each step. Users set the mission; agents execute; Sentinel QA-reviews; humans review final output.
4. **Persistent memory**: Agents maintain episodic memory across missions, building context about the customer's business over time.
5. **Dedicated infrastructure**: Each customer gets their own server deployment — data is not shared across customers.
6. **SOUL files**: Each agent's behavior is defined in a structured Markdown document (SOUL file) that specifies operational rules, quality criteria, and decision logic.
7. **Human-in-the-loop by default**: Final deliverables always go through human review before external actions are taken.

## Use Cases by Department

### Sales
- **Lead enrichment & outbound**: Scout researches prospects, Ghost writes personalized outreach sequences, Forge updates CRM records
- **CRM hygiene**: Automated data cleanup, deduplication, field standardization across Salesforce/HubSpot
- **Pipeline revival**: Identify stale deals, generate re-engagement strategies, execute multi-touch campaigns
- **Dead deal win-back**: Analyze lost reasons, craft targeted re-approach sequences

### Marketing
- **Competitive intelligence radar**: Continuous monitoring of competitor pricing, features, messaging, hiring
- **SEO content engine**: Research keywords, generate optimized articles, track rankings
- **Cross-channel reporting**: Aggregate data from Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, email into unified reports
- **Content repurposing**: Turn blog posts into social threads, newsletters, slide decks

### Customer Success
- **QBR preparation**: Auto-generate quarterly business review decks with usage data, ROI metrics, recommendations
- **Onboarding orchestration**: Create personalized onboarding plans, track milestones, trigger follow-ups
- **Upsell signal detection**: Monitor usage patterns and engagement to identify expansion opportunities
- **Client reporting autopilot**: Scheduled performance reports with AI-generated narratives

### Finance
- **Month-end close prep**: Reconcile transactions, flag discrepancies, generate close checklists
- **Expense anomaly detection**: Monitor spending patterns, flag unusual transactions, generate audit trails

### DevOps / Engineering
- **Incident response autopilot**: Detect issues, gather context, draft incident reports, coordinate response
- **Release notes autopilot**: Auto-generate release notes from Git history, Jira tickets, PR descriptions
- **Code review**: Automated PR review with quality and security checks

### Legal / Compliance
- **Contract review & risk flagging**: Analyze agreements, flag problematic clauses, suggest revisions
- **Regulatory change tracker**: Monitor regulatory updates, assess impact, generate compliance briefs

### Operations
- **Vendor renewal autopilot**: Track contract dates, benchmark pricing, generate negotiation briefs
- **Meeting-to-action autopilot**: Transcribe meetings, extract action items, create tasks in project management tools
- **Data sync & reporting**: Keep data consistent across tools, generate cross-platform reports

### E-commerce
- **Inventory restock forecasting**: Predict demand, generate purchase orders, alert on low stock
- **Flash sale launch autopilot**: Coordinate pricing, inventory, marketing, and support for promotions
- **Review & UGC harvesting**: Aggregate customer reviews, extract insights, generate response templates

### Agency
- **Client performance narrative**: Generate client-ready performance reports with AI commentary
- **Audit strategy**: Analyze client accounts and generate optimization recommendations

### HR
- **Performance review autopilot**: Gather 360 feedback, generate review drafts, track completion

## How It Works

1. **Connect your tools**: Link your CRM, communication, project management, and other tools through OAuth or API keys.
2. **Issue a mission**: Describe what you need in natural language (e.g., "Research our top 50 churning accounts and draft personalized win-back emails for each").
3. **Agents execute**: Kaze decomposes the mission, delegates subtasks to Scout, Forge, Ghost as needed. Agents work autonomously across your connected tools.
4. **Quality review**: Sentinel reviews every deliverable against quality criteria before it reaches you.
5. **Human approval**: Review final outputs in the Mission Control dashboard. Approve, edit, or request revisions.

---

## Technical Architecture

- **Frontend**: React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
- **Backend**: Convex (real-time database and serverless functions)
- **Agent Runtime**: OpenClaw agent framework running on dedicated servers
- **AI Models**: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.6 (orchestrator), Claude Sonnet 4.6 (specialist agents)
- **Infrastructure**: Dedicated per-customer deployment on AWS
- **Security**: AES-256-GCM encryption for stored credentials, OAuth 2.0 for integrations

---

## Comparison to Other Products

### vs Lindy AI
Valence is a five-agent enterprise workforce with dedicated infrastructure; Lindy is a single-agent personal assistant focused on individual productivity.

### vs Zapier / Make
Valence uses AI reasoning for autonomous decisions across multi-step workflows; Zapier and Make execute predefined rule-based triggers with no AI reasoning.

### vs CrewAI
Valence is a fully managed hosted platform with a dashboard and 100+ integrations; CrewAI is an open-source Python framework requiring engineering resources to deploy.

### vs AutoGPT
Valence is production-ready with enterprise integrations, quality gates, and persistent memory; AutoGPT is an experimental research framework.

### vs Perplexity Computer
Valence runs multi-agent server-side workflows across your entire tool stack; Perplexity Computer is a browser-based individual research tool.

### vs Claude Cowork
Valence is a team platform with five specialized agents and 100+ integrations; Claude Cowork is a desktop app for individual computer use tasks.

### vs Microsoft Copilot
Valence is stack-agnostic across 100+ tools from any vendor; Microsoft Copilot is native to Microsoft 365 and limited to the Microsoft ecosystem.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is Valence AI?**
A: Valence AI is an autonomous AI workforce platform that deploys five specialized AI agents to execute business missions across 100+ tool integrations.

**Q: How is Valence AI different from a chatbot?**
A: Chatbots respond to queries one at a time. Valence AI executes complex multi-step missions autonomously — researching, writing, coding, and updating your tools without requiring step-by-step human guidance.

**Q: What AI models does Valence AI use?**
A: Valence AI uses Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.6 for the orchestrator agent (Kaze) and Claude Sonnet 4.6 for the four specialist agents (Scout, Forge, Ghost, Sentinel).

**Q: Is my data shared with other customers?**
A: No. Each customer gets their own dedicated server deployment. Your data is never shared across customers.

**Q: How many integrations does Valence AI support?**
A: Over 100, including Salesforce, HubSpot, GitHub, Jira, Slack, Google Workspace, Notion, Stripe, Shopify, and many more.

**Q: Do I need technical skills to use Valence AI?**
A: No. You issue missions in plain English. The AI agents handle the technical execution.

**Q: How does quality control work?**
A: Sentinel, the QA agent, reviews every deliverable against quality criteria before it reaches human review. You always have final approval.

**Q: What does pricing look like?**
A: The Business plan starts at $2,499/month with all five agents, unlimited missions, and 100+ integrations. Enterprise plans start at $5,999/month with custom configuration and on-premise options.

**Q: Can I customize agent behavior?**
A: Yes. Each agent's behavior is governed by a SOUL file — a structured document that defines operational rules, quality criteria, and decision logic. Enterprise customers can customize these files.

**Q: What industries does Valence AI serve?**
A: Valence AI serves any industry that uses digital tools for business operations, including SaaS, e-commerce, financial services, agencies, professional services, and more.
